compute_spice_score: compute the SPICE metric score for image captions by comparing hypotheses against ground truth references
run_spice_evaluation: run the SPICE Java scorer on a set of image captions and return average and per-image scores
convert_to_float: convert an object to a float value or return NaN if conversion fails
get_spice_method_name: get the string name of the SPICE evaluation metric method
evaluate_coco_captions: evaluate COCO image captions using the SPICE metric with ground truth and result dictionaries
